name: spacemail-mcp
description: Let Claude check, search, read and draft replies in your Spacemail inboxes from Spaceship.
long_description:
Connect one or more Spacemail mailboxes so you can ask Claude things like "has anything come in on the support inbox today?" or "draft a friendly reply to that customer's question".

**Safe by default.** Claude writes replies as drafts in your Drafts folder so you can check them before they go. Direct sending is off unless you switch it on, and nothing is ever permanently deleted (deleting moves mail to Trash).

**Private.** Your passwords are kept in your computer's secure keychain and go only to Spacemail's own mail servers. There is no middleman server.

Built and maintained by Norwich Website Design. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Spaceship.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: See what's new across all your mailboxes, with previews

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Find emails by sender, subject, words or date

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Open an email, including its attachments list

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: Write a threaded reply and save it to Drafts

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Write a new email and save it to Drafts

tools.name: update_emails
tools.description: Mark emails read or unread, flag or unflag them

tools.name: move_emails
tools.description: Archive, move or bin emails (never permanently deletes)

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders with message and unread counts

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email (only when sending is switched on)

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Send a threaded reply (only when sending is switched on)

account_1_email.title: Mailbox 1: email address
account_1_email.description: Your full Spacemail address, e.g. hello@yourbusiness.com

account_1_password.title: Mailbox 1: password
account_1_password.description: The mailbox password (the one you use for Spacemail webmail, not your Spaceship account password). Stored in your system keychain.

account_1_label.title: Mailbox 1: nickname (optional)
account_1_label.description: A short name to refer to it by, e.g. "Support". Defaults to the domain name.

account_1_sender_name.title: Mailbox 1: sender name (optional)
account_1_sender_name.description: The name people see on emails you send, e.g. "Your Business Support".

account_2_email.title: Mailbox 2: email address (optional)
account_2_email.description: Add a second Spacemail mailbox. Leave blank if you only have one.

account_2_sender_name.title: Mailbox 2: sender name (optional)
account_2_sender_name.description: The name people see on emails from this mailbox.

account_3_email.title: Mailbox 3: email address (optional)
account_3_email.description: Add a third Spacemail mailbox. Need more? See the documentation.

account_3_label.title: Mailbox 3: nickname (optional)
account_3_label.description: A short name for the third mailbox.

account_3_sender_name.title: Mailbox 3: sender name (optional)
account_3_sender_name.description: The name people see on emails from this mailbox.

allow_send.title: Allow Claude to send emails directly
allow_send.description: Off (recommended): Claude saves replies as drafts for you to check and send. On: Claude can also send emails when you ask it to.
